    Munge data for journey visualization plot

    munge_journey.Rd

    This function provides the initial munging steps to process the data in a way that can then be handled by plot_journey

    munge_journey(df, applicant, pilot_pd)

    Arguments

    df

    Mixpanel dataframe

    applicant

    an applicant's distinct_id

    pilot_pd

    can limit this to a particular pilot, eg "Nov 2025"

    Value

    processed dataframe for use with plot_journey

    See also

    plot_journey for how data are munged for viz

    Other app_journey: plot_journey()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df_mp <- read_parquet(mp_path)

df_mp %>%
  munge_journey("applicant-123456") %>% 
  plot_journey(export = "../Images/")
} # }
